merknad: Seksjonsstruktur, titler og korte hovedsitater fra NBIMs offentlige retningslinjer. Nøkkelordene er teamets egne og brukes bare til gjenfinning.

GVG 1.1.sitat: The board should guide company strategy and monitor management performance without conflicts of interest.
GVG 1.1.nokkelord: independent independence non-independent non-executive director board majority controlled company dominant shareholder elect election minority nominated cumulative voting outside director

GVG 1.2.sitat: Board decisions that are particularly vulnerable to conflicts of interest should have additional safeguards.
GVG 1.2.nokkelord: audit committee remuneration committee compensation committee executive director member committee independent inside director

GVG 1.3.sitat: The board should exercise objective judgement on corporate affairs and be able to make decisions independently of management.
GVG 1.3.nokkelord: chairperson chairman chair ceo chief executive separate separation roles combined independent board chair authorisation serve

GVG 2.1.sitat: Board members should devote sufficient time to fulfil their responsibilities effectively.
GVG 2.1.nokkelord: time commitment overboarding boards directorships attendance attended meetings chair roles

GVG 2.2.sitat: The board should have a thorough understanding of the industry in which the company operates.
GVG 2.2.nokkelord: industry expertise experience competence nomination committee chair non-executive worked

GVG 2.3.sitat: Diversity contributes to the overall effectiveness of the board and is a sign of an effective nomination process.
GVG 2.3.nokkelord: diversity gender women female nomination committee chair board composition

GVG 3.1.sitat: Shareholders should be able to participate in frequent elections of all board members, preferably on an annual basis.
GVG 3.1.nokkelord: classify declassify staggered board term annual election elect director nominee proxy access majority voting cumulative voting disclosed name

GVG 3.2.sitat: Shareholders should have the right to seek changes to the board when it does not act in their best interest.
GVG 3.2.nokkelord: discharge liability responsibility board conduct re-elect reelect failure oversight misconduct governance risk shareholder requests supervisory management board performance

GVG 3.3.sitat: The board is responsible for attracting the right CEO and setting appropriate remuneration.
GVG 3.3.nokkelord: remuneration compensation pay policy report executive ceo vesting holding severance golden parachute pension incentive say-on-pay named executive officers bonus

GVG 4.1.sitat: All shareholders should have the right to vote on fundamental corporate decisions, and voting rights should be proportionate to cash flow rights.
GVG 4.1.nokkelord: voting rights class shares unequal dual-class one share one vote voting cap recapitalization common stock

GVG 4.2.sitat: Shareholders should in certain circumstances have the opportunity to raise issues of material importance without having to wait for management to schedule a meeting.
GVG 4.2.nokkelord: general meeting special meeting call meeting written consent bundled de-bundle agenda items virtual

GVG 4.3.sitat: The right to vote on fundamental changes affecting the company is a basic right of shareholders.
GVG 4.3.nokkelord: articles association bylaws amend amendments governing documents charter statute rules procedures

GVG 5.1.sitat: The external auditor should act in an independent manner.
GVG 5.1.nokkelord: auditor auditors audit firm appoint ratify non-audit fees statutory auditor accounting

GVG 5.2.sitat: We will not support an agenda item if the information disclosed is insufficient to make an informed decision, e.g. the agenda item "other business".
GVG 5.2.nokkelord: financial statements annual report accounts statutory reports disclosure other business insufficient information

GVG 5.3.sitat: The board should account for material sustainability risks facing the company, and the broader environmental and social consequences of its operations and products.
GVG 5.3.nokkelord: sustainability climate emissions greenhouse environmental social report disclosure human rights lobbying political transition

GVG 6.1.sitat: Existing shareholders should have the right to approve share issuances in order to prevent the dilution of ownership without their prior consent.
GVG 6.1.nokkelord: issuance issue shares pre-emptive preemptive rights capital increase authorised authorized capital dilution warrants convertible

GVG 6.2.tittel: Mergers, acquisitions and other corporate transactions
GVG 6.2.sitat: Mergers, acquisitions and other corporate transactions should maximise shareholder value.
GVG 6.2.nokkelord: merger acquisition transaction takeover anti-takeover poison pill rights plan supermajority spin-off disposal absorption share exchange

GVG 6.3.sitat: Transactions with related parties should be carried out on market terms and be clearly beneficial to all shareholders.
GVG 6.3.nokkelord: related-party related party transactions connected transaction market terms affiliate
